आवाज़ उठाओ — raise your voice

Awaaz Run

Delhi, Day 1. The government refuses to hear the protest, so the city takes it to the streets: a march on Jantar Mantar, the old observatory where every movement of the last century has raised its voice. You are one protester among thousands. Get to the rally point through police cordons, keep fellow marchers out of the vans, beat the ministers' swagger out of their cars, and raise the Tiranga to claim the day. The movement continues tomorrow.

Police are coming out of 21 real stations across Delhi, they're putting up barricades on the roads into Jantar Mantar, and they'll take anyone they catch to the nearest police station. Duck into shops to shake them off, find a way around the barricades, and raise the Tiranga when you get there.

More stars mean more, faster police
Anonymous play. You are Protester. No sign-in, no name, no cookies, no saved data, no analytics. Fonts and map data come with the game. Satellite view loads image tiles from Esri's servers, which see your IP address like any online map.
